responsibility: Implements LRA’s largest and central RTL transformation phase for satisfying machine constraints. It chooses insn alternatives, creates reload insns and reload pseudos, substitutes equivalent constants or memory values, performs inheritance and live-range-splitting transformations in EBB scope, and later undoes failed inheritance/split decisions or removes optional reloads when assignment results make them unprofitable. This file is the main constraint-solving engine that repeatedly rewrites RTL to make every insn and address satisfy target operand constraints.
